title: WindowsPatchSettings
description: Specifies settings related to VM Guest Patching on Windows.

patchMode.description: Specifies the mode of VM Guest Patching to IaaS virtual machine.

assessmentMode.description: Specifies the mode of VM Guest Patch Assessment for the IaaS virtual machine.

enableHotpatching.description: Enables customers to patch their Azure VMs without requiring a reboot.
